column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
*sigh*...
So in order to wait for Kirino who had gone off shopping again, I had no choice but to continue to sit on the bench.
It's an improvement not being told to go with her, I thought.
This might be a good thing...
Oh? It's Kyou-chan!
Ah, Manami...
What's wrong? Are you by yourself?
Um, that is, ah, no, that's...
I came to buy some ingredients for our family store.
What? Is this some spot for running into people you know?
The brightly smiling Manami somehow looked uncomfortable.
Probably, it was from that phone call earlier.
Oh yes, what was that phone call earlier about?
Ah, no, that was... um...
After that, you sent a mail saying you were too busy playing this p-perverted game for the sake of fully finishing it... Did you finish it?
Pff!  Augh!  Augh!  It's over!  Nooo!
Kirino... She...!
Ugh, my chest is hurting..
Even though Manami meant no ill will, each word felt like a stab to the heart.
Ah, that's right.  I told you we made a new one.  Next time, come try it, okay?
Ah, I'll do that.
We haven't put it in the store yet. Grandpa said to wait until we've asked you to test it.
So if I said "Gross!", what would you guys do?
Fufufufu... That won't happen.
Then that's fine then.  So, is it okay for you to be talking here?
Ah, that's right!  Well, I'll contact you later, Kyou-chan.
Yeah!  See ya...
Yeah. Oh yeah, Kyou-chan...
What is it?
D-Don't play so many perverted games, okay?
Pffffff!
Well, see ya, Kyou-chan.
*sighhh*....
As I stared at the figure of Manami disappearing into the distance, I unconsciously let out a long sigh.
Why me...  How has she come to think of me like that?
Hey you, you look kinda pale.
And whose fault is that?
Hm?  Like I would know that. Okay, the next shop is...
